contribution.title: Bucketed parallel core-cell connectivity
contribution.summary: Connect neighboring DBSCAN core cells by bucketing candidate work and merging discovered core-point connections with parallel union-find, reducing redundant distance tests and synchronization while preserving exact DBSCAN connectivity.
contribution.paper_location: Section 4.4, Algorithm 3; practical higher-dimensional exact implementation in Section 6.2
contribution.metric: Exact DBSCAN correctness is a hard gate, including core/border/noise status and all memberships of ambiguous border points; the primary metric is paired, repeated elapsed computation time through the preserved CLI at a pinned worker count on bounded SS-style similar/varied-density and uniform-fill workloads in 3D and 7D across multiple epsilon/minPts settings.
